Remove the replication-progress trend from a replication tensor

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity.R
correct_replication_tensor.Rd

Apply correct_signal_matrix() to the tensor flattened to cells x (IZ, position).

Usage

correct_replication_tensor(
  x,
  progress,
  method = c("bin", "spline"),
  n_progress_bins = 10L,
  spline_df = 4L,
  keep_fitted = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

Array, cells x IZs x positions (e.g. build_replication_tensor()).

progress

Replication progress of the cells.

method

"bin" or "spline".

n_progress_bins

Number of progress bins.

spline_df

Spline degrees of freedom.

keep_fitted

Logical; also return the fitted tensor.

Value

A list with residual, fitted (or NULL) and method.
